title: Relationship Pricing Grades: The Rate a Certificate of Deposit Penalty Is Charged At
content:
The rate at which a penalty on a certificate of the Certificates of Deposit line is charged is graded by the checking account the owner holds and by whether that account predates the term now running.

## 1. The grades

The rate the penalty is charged at is graded: an owner holding an active checking account of a tier the certificate's own tier lists as qualifying, opened before the term now running began, is charged at the rate the term carries less the tier's relationship bonus points; an owner holding an active checking account of a tier that does not qualify, opened before the term now running began, is charged at the tier's published standard interest rate; every other owner is charged at the rate the term carries.

## 2. The accounts and the dates

The accounts are accounts of the bank's Personal Checking line. Two things are asked of the one the owner holds: whether its tier appears on the list of qualifying checking tiers the certificate's own tier publishes, and whether the day it was opened falls before the day the term now running began.

## 3. Condition and result

| Active checking account | Opened before the term now running began | Rate the penalty is charged at |
|---|---|---|
| of a tier the certificate's tier lists as qualifying | yes | the rate the term carries, less the tier's relationship bonus points |
| of a tier the certificate's tier does not list as qualifying | yes | the tier's published standard interest rate |
| of a tier the certificate's tier lists as qualifying | no | the rate the term carries |
| of a tier the certificate's tier does not list as qualifying | no | the rate the term carries |
| none held | — | the rate the term carries |

## 4. Worked readings, on hypothetical figures

A certificate whose term carries 4.12 percent, on a tier publishing relationship bonus points of 0.15 and a standard interest rate of 3.97 percent, whose term began on 1 June.

| The owner's checking account | Result |
|---|---|
| Premier Checking, active, opened 14 March, a qualifying tier | 3.97 percent, being 4.12 less 0.15 |
| Everyday Checking, active, opened 14 March, not a qualifying tier | 3.97 percent, the tier's published standard rate |
| Premier Checking, active, opened 20 August | 4.12 percent, the rate the term carries |
| none | 4.12 percent, the rate the term carries |

That the first two rows arrive at the same figure here is a coincidence of these hypothetical numbers: one is the term's rate stripped of the relationship points, the other the tier's published standard rate, and they part company wherever the term's rate carries the jumbo bonus as well or was set on a different day's sheet.

An account opened on the very day the term began was not opened before it, and so meets neither of the first two grades.
